frpm.county name: Stores full county name (e.g., 'Alameda'), contrary to its misleading description claiming it is a county code.
satscores.cds: 12-digit SAT-reporting CDS code with '1' prepended to the standard 14-digit CDSCode (e.g., '1100170109835') to distinguish SAT data from CALPADS data.
satscores.rtype: Indicates data level: 'S' for school-level SAT scores, 'D' for district-level aggregated scores.
satscores.dname: Full name of the district associated with the SAT data, not merely a 'segment' as described.
schools.charter: Text field where '1' indicates a charter school and 'None' indicates non-charter (not a boolean 0/1 as described).
schools.magnet: Text field where '0' indicates not a magnet school and 'None' indicates unknown or unreported — inconsistent with claimed boolean 1/0 format.
schools.eilcode: Short code representing the institution's grade-span level (e.g., 'HS', 'ELEMHIGH'), mapping to eilname for full interpretation.
schools.eilname: Full textual description of the grade-span level (e.g., 'High School') corresponding to the eilcode.
schools.doc: Numeric code identifying the district's ownership type (e.g., '00'), linked to doctype for human-readable interpretation.
schools.edopscode: Short code denoting the educational model (e.g., 'TRAD'), paired with edopsname for detailed definition.
schools.gsoffered: Grade range the school officially offers (e.g., 'K-12'), which may exceed the grades actually served per CALPADS.
schools.gsserved: Grade range of students actually enrolled, as reported in CALPADS Fall 1 data — limited to K-12 range.
schools.virtual: Type of virtual instruction: 'N' for none, 'P' for partial, 'F' for full (though 'F' is rarely observed).
schools.admfname3: Third administrator’s first name, used in some districts; contrary to description, it is populated and useful.
schools.admlname3: Third administrator’s last name, used in some districts; contrary to description, it is populated and useful.
schools.admemail3: Third administrator’s email, used in some districts; contrary to description, it is populated and useful.
